acquisition_method.evidence: Ultimately, the separated peptides were analyzed in Q Exactive HF-X (Thermo Fisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) for DDA (Data Dependent Acquisition) mode detection.

fractionation_method.evidence: Then the peptides were pooled and purified using a 5 μm 4.6 × 250 mm Gemini C18 column with an LC-20AB liquid phase system (Shimadzu, Tokyo, Japan).
